releaseNotes:
迎接云端 AI 时代，EchoBird 已支持全球五款主流云端 Agent：Grok Bot、Manus、Cue、Muse、Dot（ChatGPT 内置）！

releaseNotesI18n.en:
Embrace the cloud AI era! EchoBird now supports five leading cloud agents worldwide: Grok Bot, Manus, Cue, Muse, and Dot (built into ChatGPT)!

- Put user experience first with substantial UI refinements and a wide range of polished interaction animations.
